b_source: NH DOE DOE-25, General Fund equity June 30 less July 1
b_where: raw/nh-doe25 DOE25_id2221.xlsx, DOE25 sheet, Statement of Analysis of Change in Fund Equity
note: The two documents disagree about whether the General Fund ran a surplus or a deficit: FY2019 (audit -$146K, DOE-25 +$294K), FY2022 (audit -$109K, DOE-25 +$158K) and FY2024 (audit +$286K, DOE-25 -$139K) have opposite signs; the other four years agree on direction but not on size. The audit includes transfers and items the DOE-25's revenue and expenditure lines treat differently; the business office can reconcile the two.
